note: Triennial election of the Castlereagh rural district councillors. A contest was threatened in Ballycultra, but Mr. J. H. Murphy withdrew, so all nine divisions were returned unopposed and there was no poll. Filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballyhackmore' to Ballyhackamore (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Castlereagh Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Ballyhackamore; the rounds were filed as Ballyhackamore (1924, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964, 1967); Ballyhackmore (1927). This round was filed as 'Ballyhackmore', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (ballyhackmore) answers with a redirect to this one.
